description: This is a shell script file containing a series of automated tests for Git's sparse checkout functionality. It sets up a Git repository, configures sparse checkouts, and verifies behavior of 'read-tree', 'checkout', and related commands with various patterns and options. The script includes setup steps, test cases with expected results, and checks for correct worktree updates, index states, and warnings.

methods.name: read_tree_u_must_succeed
methods.description: Ensures that the 'read_tree' operation completes successfully with specified options.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting successful execution.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares files or output for equality.

methods.name: test_path_is_file
methods.description: Checks if a given path exists and is a file.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Checks if a given path does not exist.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Verifies that output or a file is empty.
